name: dataset_read
description: Read shared datasets: list them, or read one's value, hash, status (ok/stale/empty), editable, warnings and the pages using it; path (e.g. a[id=o1].b) narrows the value. refresh:true fetches online data now. sinceHash (e.g. from page_read datasetBases) returns record-level changes since then, paged with offset/limit. query {filter, sorts, search} reads a {columns, rows} value as records with derived values, filtered like a database view. out writes the value or comparison to a JSON file. Actions: list{}; read{datasetId,path?,sinceHash?,offset?,limit?,refresh?,query?,out?,overwrite?}.

name: dataset_write
description: Change shared datasets (guide datasets). create: value, or fromBlock {pageId,blockId,baseHash} to share and bind a block's props. apply: read baseHash + operations {op:"set",path,value}, {op:"remove",path}, {op:"insert",path:list,value,after?}, {op:"move",path:item,after}; path selects records by id ([id=t1]). link url: online json/csv/tsv/xlsx, read-only. transform: read-only data from script "function transform(inputs, helpers)", inputs {name:datasetId}; dryRun:true runs it unsaved. link path: value in a local json/csv/tsv file (xlsx read-only); path:null copies it back. *File fields read from a file. Actions: create{name,datasetId?,description?,value?,valueFile?,schema?,fromBlock?}; apply{datasetId,baseHash,operations?,operationsFile?,name?,description?,schema?}; link{datasetId?,path?,url?,format?,refreshSeconds?,use?,name?,description?,value?,valueFile?,schema?,baseHash?}; transform{datasetId?,baseHash?,name?,description?,schema?,inputs?,script?,scriptFile?,dryRun?}.

name: dataset_delete
description: Delete a dataset that no block uses; otherwise fails with details.references.

name: organization_read
description: Read project folders, deleted items that can be restored, or this connection's sidebar groups and project order. Actions: folders{includeArchived?}; deleted{}; sidebar{}.

name: organization_update
description: Change folders, pages, this project or the sidebar. archived:true deletes (restorable, listed by organization_read deleted), archived:false restores. parentId is a folder or null for the root; page moves need baseHash/baseRevision; sectionId is projects, pinned or a sidebar group; update_group with name:null removes it. Actions: create_folder{name,icon?,parentId?}; update_folder{folderId,name?,icon?,pinned?,archived?}; update_project{name?,icon?,pinned?,archived?}; update_page{pageId,archived?,pinned?,baseHash?,baseRevision?}; duplicate_page{pageId,title?}; sort{parentId,sortBy}; move{kind,id,destinationProjectId?,parentId,relativeId?,placement?,reorderOnly?,baseHash?,baseRevision?}; create_group{name}; update_group{sidebarGroupId,name}; move_project{sectionId,relativeProjectId?,placement?}.

name: catalog_references
description: Find where a component or template is referenced in this project's pages and packages; version/integrity narrow the target.

name: draft_read
description: Read editor drafts in this project's connection workspace; drafts are not formal content and do not sync. Actions: list{clientId?,resourceId?,kind?}; read{draftId}.

name: draft_write
description: Save an editable draft, or complete a page draft after saving its exact content. Actions: save{kind,clientId,resourceId,content?,baseRevision?,baseContent?,title?,sequence?}; complete{draftId,generation,revision}.

name: draft_remove
description: Discard a reviewed draft generation; a newer generation returns CONFLICT.

name: guide
description: Read a focused ShowAI guide; without topic, list the guides.

name: template_context
description: Read the selected templates whole for this task: README, every guide and the template component index, with exact refs. templates:[] records only the system workflow ref.

name: project_context
description: Return the project and its compact component index (names, descriptions, scenarios, props signatures) with the index revision.

name: pages_list
description: List pages with titles, IDs and hashes.

name: page_read
description: Read a Page as structured JSON/Markdown (default), a PNG image, or html (DOM, accessibility tree and an interactive file; actions run interactions). detail:"outline" lists block IDs; blockIds selects blocks. out (absolute path) writes the source, markdown, image or html to a file and returns only its path, sha256, hash and revision.

name: board_read
description: Read a Board: a full image for small boards, otherwise an overview with overlapping tiles and element/Page indexes. Pass the returned snapshotId with mode tile/region/element/source for details. boardId selects a Board inside a Page.

name: page_create
description: Create a Page or Board. Prefer blocks:[{kind,data}] in reading order, e.g. {kind:"text",data:{format:"markdown",content:"..."}}, and add more with page_apply component.insert. import:{source, importer?, dryRun?} imports a file, folder or zip path into parentId instead (guide import).

name: page_save
description: Save a full Page document with its baseHash; stale content returns CONFLICT. Replies with a receipt (hash, revision, changedBlocks); response:"source" adds the saved document.

name: page_apply
description: Apply operations by stable block id with the Page's baseHash. Insert components with {type:"component.insert",kind,data,parentId?,afterId?}, change their data with {type:"component.props.set",blockId,props} and switch a custom component to another revision with {type:"component.ref.set",blockId,version,integrity,componentId?} (keeps id and props). Comment with {type:"comment",text,blockId?,quote?} or {type:"comment",threadId,text?,resolved?}; page_read returns open comments. Other operations: guide authoring. Replies with a receipt whose changedBlocks.added lists new block ids; response:"source" adds the document. operationsFile reads the operations array from a JSON file.

name: page_diff
description: Compare a Page with an earlier read hash or revision: one entry per record-level change (lists of records by id), long values summarized, paged with offset/nextOffset; blockIds narrows it. out writes every entry unabridged to a JSON file.

name: page_export
description: Export a Page as HTML, an inline conversation fragment or a static site at out; blockIds exports part of it. Files of this device (or data computed from them) return CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED with details.packaging (items, sizes, choices); repeat with packaging {itemId: choice} after the person decides.

name: catalog_list
description: List component and template names, descriptions, scenarios and one-line props signatures. Defaults to built-ins plus this project's components; scope selects global/published/all; limit/cursor paginate. kind contribution lists extension slots and what fills them.

name: catalog_describe
description: Describe a component or template. view: summary (default), guide (use contract, schema, example), parameters (paged by parameterPath/offset/limit), development, examples, dependencies, source or full. With view source, out (absolute folder) writes the component's whole package there for editing and component_save directory.

name: component_save
description: Save component source as a new immutable revision in this project: source inline, or directory, the absolute path of a package folder on this device (manifest.json, props.schema.json, entry and files), read without copying it into the call. Same contract for both; legacy:true imports an old package without manifest.documentation.

name: template_apply
description: Create a resource from a template, or insert it into pageId with its baseHash/baseRevision and optional parentId.

name: template_save
description: Create an immutable project template from pageId or input:{bundle:{format:1,files,assets?}}; bundled components are compiled and registered.

name: catalog_version
description: Save a project-owned revision (fork an exact revision, or save a reviewed merge), or remove a revision; remove without version removes every revision in that scope and refuses with IN_USE while pages, packages or publications use it. importer saves an importer (guide import). Actions: importer{manifest,script}; remove{kind,id,version?,scope?}; fork{ref,id?,version,name?}; merge{base,ours,theirs,id?,version,resolved}.

name: catalog_merge_preview
description: Preview a three-way merge without writing; view:"source" returns the candidate and conflict values.

name: publication_prepare
description: Prepare local static publication files from exact refs.

name: publication_list
description: List verified publication references in the local shared library.

name: library_search
description: Search this project's pages, containers and component/template descriptions and source; returns node locations.

name: page_merge_preview
description: Compare a local draft, its base and the current Page.

name: page_merge_save
description: Save a reviewed merged Page, rechecking the current revision.

name: workspace_conflict
description: Read retained external file changes in this project: list them, or read one with its formal and baseline versions. Actions: list{}; read{id}.

name: workspace_resolve
description: Resolve an external change by discard, page import or reviewed merge (preserved snapshots remain available), or recover an external package change as an editable local draft and restore the immutable version. Actions: resolve{id,resolution,document?}; recover_package{id,clientId}.

name: project_sync_status
description: Return synchronization status for this project.

name: project_sync
description: Synchronize this connected project and return status, error and remoteHead. packaging {itemId: bundle|skip} first stores the person's choice of which files of this device travel with it.

name: page_present
description: Present a saved Page, or selected blocks inline, and return host delivery references. display.reader is the inline preview's reader; readerReason says why it loads from the CDN. externalSnapshots lists embedded data from files outside the library; get the person's agreement before sharing those files.

name: showai_capabilities
description: Return this connection's ShowAI capabilities.

name: public_catalog_list

name: public_catalog_describe

name: render_document
description: Render a complete standalone document from public components/templates or supplied sources without saving it.

document.description: Complete ShowAI document. Custom nodes are {type:'widget',attrs:{id,kind:'custom',data:{componentId,version,props}}}.

componentSources.description: Unsaved component packages (manifest, schema, source, files, assets).

blockIds.description: Node IDs to show inline; HTML and source keep the full document.

name: show_component
description: Show 1–5 components in the conversation without saving. kind/data match page_apply component.insert, so the same component can later be saved in a Page.

kind.description: Component kind, e.g. chart, flowchart or custom.

data.description: Component data as in component.insert; custom components use {componentId,version,props}.

blocks.description: Several components in order, each {kind,data}, instead of kind/data.

projectId.description: Project whose saved custom components to resolve.

componentSources.description: Unsaved component packages (manifest, schema, source, files, assets).

title.description: Accessible name and host card title.

delivery.description: auto follows the plugin's declared host display.

name: projects_list
description: List projects in this library.

name: project_resolve
description: Resolve the user's project directory (absolute sourceDirectory) to its project, creating the mapping if missing.

name: project_create
description: Create a separately named project.
